description: This file defines the 'Vtiger_MailScannerInfo' class, which manages mail scanner configurations, including initialization, database interactions, folder management, and rules handling within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Manages mail scanner configuration, including access to database records, folder info, rules, and operational status within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mail scanner info object, optionally loading data for a given scanner name.

methods.name: __crypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts the given password.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads scanner configuration data from the database based on scanner name.

methods.name: initializeFolderInfo
methods.description: Loads folder scan info related to the scanner from the database.

methods.name: clearLastscan
methods.description: Deletes last scan records for the current scanner.

methods.name: updateAllFolderRescan
methods.description: Sets the rescan flag for all associated folders.

methods.name: updateLastscan
methods.description: Updates last scan time or schedules rescan for a specific folder.

methods.name: getLastscan
methods.description: Returns the last scan date for a specific folder.

methods.name: needRescan
methods.description: Checks whether a folder requires rescanning.

methods.name: checkRescan
methods.description: Checks if any folder requires rescanning and returns the folder name if so.

methods.name: updateFolderInfo
methods.description: Updates folder list and rescan flags based on provided folder names.

methods.name: enableFoldersForScan
methods.description: Enables only specified folders for scanning.

methods.name: initializeRules
methods.description: Loads associated mail scanner rules from the database.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns scanner information as a map/object for external use.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares current scanner object with another for equality based on filter parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Creates or updates the scanner configuration in the database; loads new data from another instance.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the scanner configuration and related data from the database.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all mail scanners configured in the system.
